name: Veriss Payments
summary: Payment platform for organizations such as professional bodies, schools and unions: they create dues, event, donation and fundraising services, collect money through Paystack straight into their own bank accounts, and give payers receipts anyone can verify.
description: Veriss Payments is the core of the Veriss platform at payment.veriss.co. Organizations add settlement bank accounts, which are verified with Paystack and become Paystack subaccounts. They then create payment services with an amount, a payment window, custom questions for payers and rules for who may pay: subscribers, the public, specific users or specific emails. Members and guests pay online and get receipts with a QR code that links to a public verification page. Organizations can also take payments from their own websites through an API checkout with signed requests, a verify API and signed webhooks, documented at /developers. One Express 5 app serves the JSON API and a Vue 3 + Tailwind frontend backed by MongoDB, and every amount is stored in kobo.
